reason: A gives remote staff what they need to decide whether to stay: up to $150 a month toward commuting, desks arriving before the start date, a six-month review with staff, and a plain statement that there are no exceptions beyond the four. It also names a real sender and gives the meeting time. B covers the same reasons but leaves out every one of those commitments and is signed with placeholder names, so it feels vaguer and less trustworthy.
